statements.statement: FY27 budget cycle will be difficult; major cost drivers (health insurance, retirement assessment, school transportation) exceed revenue growth, so absent service reductions an override is likely required.
Free cash has not yet been certified, which directly affects town meeting planning for the capital plan, reserve transfers, and the snow and ice deficit.
School committee discussed the school budget's healthcare figures, then learned the actual healthcare numbers are lower, so the budget will have to be adjusted downward accordingly.
Draft warrant article proposes a multi-year allocation of $15,000 for the town's 300th anniversary.
